title.narrative: KINDANGO KOBELA TI DE (Fighting to Eradicate Malaria) - Central African Republic (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Central African Republic, Malaria, World Vision International (WVI CAR)This program has the following goals: By the end of 2020, 40% reduction in malaria morbidity and mortality in the general population compared to the 2016 level.. The objectives of this program are: Protect at least 80 % of the population with effective vector control interventions by the end of 2020.. Increase IPT coverage (IPTi, ITPg 3) to at least 80% by the end of 2020.. Ensure the adequate case management (in line with national guidelines) of at least 80% of malaria cases by the end of 2020.. Strengthen the system of monitoring and evaluation including malaria surveillance and operational research by the end of 2020.. At least 80 % of the population adopting adequate behaviors for the fight against malaria by the end of 2020.. Building of capacitites of the Program at all levels (institutional,managerial and technical) by the end of 2020.. Ensure the availability of quality antimalarial drugs and other commodities to at least 80% of the public, private and faith-based health facilities and targetted communities by the end of 2020.
